# P11 repair progress

Verified recovery against disk: all nine fixtures already existed (the supplied changed-file inventory omitted six); earlier missing-fixture diagnosis is withdrawn. The prior attempt left integrations.json absent and result.md unfinished. Two actual test failures were repaired: decimal inputs now use decimal-text rational conversion; the expected-value poison test runs against an isolated package root without weakening P03 package-path validation or modifying frozen bytes.

Implemented additional exchange-result validation, deterministic no-fallback and version-drift checks, per-case independent arithmetic oracles, and phase-entry hashes for protected inputs/controller files. Discovery found Arelle, QuantLib, Docling, Beancount, Ledger, hledger and ACTUS absent in the recorded interpreter/PATH; no engine installed or downloaded, zero integrations completed. All six matched executions agree. P11 and P03 tests and the artifact checker have run; final records are being checked and result.md finalized.

Changed source/test files: scripts/accounting_integrations_v1.py, scripts/demo_debt_execution_v1.py, scripts/check_accounting_p11.py, tests/test_accounting_p11.py. All nine docs/design/fixtures/p11 files are retained phase contributions. Deliverables: integrations.json, result.md, progress.md. Exact hashes and complete test outputs are in integrations.json.

Next: finalize result.md with actual test counts, adapter statuses, decisions, engineering/accounting/forecast/human limits and residual work; verify current file hashes match the manifest. Required external exchanges remain unavailable. No usability superiority or wider G2/G9/MC01–MC35 closure follows.
